subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as a LINE/plugin-owned opt-in buffer, a generic channel SDK/gateway coalescer, or deferred in favor of narrow channel-specific fixes?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes channel ownership, public config, latency, reply-token handling, and agent turn boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent product/API contract.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
options.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, using shared helpers only where they prevent immediate duplication.

options.title: Design a generic coalescer
options.body: Create a broader channel SDK or gateway media coalescing contract before channel-specific implementation, accepting larger compatibility and API review.

options.title: Defer broad batching
options.body: Keep Telegram album handling and text debounce as supported behavior while handling only narrower channel bugs such as WhatsApp steer media loss.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media batching
recommendation.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in the affected channel plugin first, using shared helpers only where they prevent immediate duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across cross-channel media handling, config compatibility, and plugin-boundary decisions for this issue.
